content.description: Echo Protocol is a Bitcoin liquidity aggregation and yield layer (BTCFi) built on Move-based blockchains, including Aptos and Movement. It makes idle BTC productive through its 1:1 Bitcoin-backed token, aBTC. This liquid staking solution allows users to bring Bitcoin liquidity into DeFi while holding the underlying asset, unlocking new possibilities. The protocol unifies fragmented BTC standards and offers automated yield strategies through 'Vaults' to optimize returns. Echo features the eMSTR strategy, providing leveraged Bitcoin exposure without liquidation risk, simplifying the process for users to earn yield while maintaining top-tier security for all assets.
